title: International Seaways to Announce Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results on February 26, 2026
summary: International Seaways, Inc. (NYSE: INSW) (the “Company” or “INSW”) announced today that it plans to release fourth quarter and full year 2025 results before market open on Thursday, February 26, 2026. The Company will host a conference call for investors at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time (“ET”) on the same day. Conference Call Details: Date: Thursday, February 26, 2026 Time 9:00 AM ET Dial-in Numbers US: +1 (833) 470-1428 International: +1 (929) 526-1599 Conference ID 699376 A live webcast of the conference call will be available from the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at https://www.intlseas.com/ . An audio replay of the conference call will be available starting at 12:00 p.m. ET on Thursday, February 26, 2026 through 11:59 p.m. ET on Thursday, March 5, 2026 by dialing +1 (866) 813-9403 for domestic callers and +44 204 525 0658 for international callers, and entering Access Code 715232.
